steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In April 2022, Equity Mates described Cobalt Blue Holdings’ Broken Hill project as working to supply cobalt into the battery supply chain, mentioning end users like LG and Samsung, to give manufacturers more supplier choice beyond the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

views.text: In July 2026, Equity Mates noted Cobalt Blue was a tiny ASX-listed, pre-revenue pure cobalt play with a $49 million market cap.

views.text: In April 2022, Equity Mates said cobalt companies’ market caps were much smaller than other mineral producers and discussed Cobalt Blue alongside peers cited at about $53.5 million and $60.5 million to frame the cohort’s scale.
